preconditions.description: The number of denominations is between 2 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c <= 10**6 for c in denominations) and denominations[0] == 1
preconditions.description: The first denomination is 1, and all denominations are positive integers ≤ 10^6.
The input contains exactly n denominations, sorted in strictly increasing order.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'canonical' if all(greedy_coins(x) == min_coins(x) for x in range(1, sum_two_largest + 1)) else 'non-canonical'
postconditions.description: The output is 'canonical' if the greedy algorithm matches the minimum coins for all amounts up to the sum of the two largest denominations; otherwise, it is 'non-canonical'.
